title: VPG Engine — Arena stages
description: The stages an arena can be built on, and which floor, barricade and outer pieces fit each one. An arena names a stage id; the editor offers only the pieces listed here, because the sets are modelled to fit together and mixing them leaves gaps.

schema_version.description: Optional stages schema version. Current version is 1.

id.description: Stage identifier, as an arena file's `stage` field names it.

piece_list.description: Pieces that fit this stage. The first is the default an arena gets when it selects the stage.
